subject: which read ends an inline track rename in Logic: the bisection of the idle poll's reads
question: With no server running, an inline track rename open, which of the reads an idle poll cycle makes, made once a second from another process, moves the keyboard focus off the rename field?

reverify.command: python3 Scripts/livekit/probe_1079_which_read_ends_the_rename.py <out.json> --samples 3 (run as /usr/bin/python3 with LPM_LIVE_LOCK naming a held lock, no server running, Logic open on a project with a selected track)
reverify.expected: only the conditions that read AXHelp in the tracks area (walk_help and header_help) lose the field, in every sample; every other condition keeps it in every sample; the one-at-a-time search stops on an element beside the track headers

method: No server ran. Probe head b9375042. Per condition and sample, Track > Rename Track was opened on the selected track and the rename field recorded by its frame once it read as a text field with a string value. Then once a second for up to 8 s the condition's reads were made from /usr/bin/python3 and the focused element read; lost means the focus was no longer that field at that frame. A last pass, help_one_by_one, opened the rename and read AXHelp of one element at a time across Logic's windows, reading the focused element's role after each, and stopped at the first read after which it was no longer a text field.

observations.read: osascript: count of documents, then path of front document, as LogicProjectFileReader asks
the track headers' text fields, sliders and checkboxes: AXValue and AXDescription
the application's focused and main window and focused element, and every window's title, document, sheets, modal flag, role, subrole, main and focused flags
every element of every window to depth 12: AXRole and AXDescription
every element of every window to depth 12: AXValue and AXTitle
every element of every window to depth 12: AXHelp
the elements under the group the canon names the mixer, to depth 6: AXHelp
the track headers and their descendants to depth 4: AXHelp (inferTrackType)

observations.reading: AXHelp one element at a time, focus read after each
AXHelp one element at a time, focus read after each

conclusion: Reading AXHelp of tracks-area elements ended the rename: header_help, walk_help lost the field in every sample, while header_values, mixer_help, none, osascript, walk_roles, walk_values, window_meta kept it in every sample. The one-element search stopped on AXButton whose parent is AXGroup.
limits: Korean only, one fixture, the sample count per condition recorded above.
Only the tracks area and the mixer were tested for help reads; other areas were not.
Why Logic ends the edit on a help read was not read.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record states which kinds of AX read kept or lost the rename field, by role and count; it quotes no string Logic ships.
